new_categories.label: terminal_dry_bulk_dust_control_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Terminal dry-bulk dust-control assurance can be represented as a delivered service-state distinct from berth-transfer readiness, storage/reclaim readiness and downstream environmental outcomes.

new_categories.label: transfer_point_source_zone_containment_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded transfer-point source-zone containment confidence can be represented without retaining exact cargo, enclosure, chute, seal, hood or equipment details.

new_categories.label: stockyard_source_zone_containment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Stockyard or storage-area dust-source containment confidence can be represented separately from transfer-point containment and from stored-cargo availability.

new_categories.label: dust_suppression_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: A non-specific dust-suppression service readiness state can be separated from physical source containment without retaining medium, settings, rates or operating method.

new_categories.label: dust_extraction_capture_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Extraction or capture readiness can be represented separately from suppression and source containment without retaining fan, duct, hood, filter or capture-rate details.

new_categories.label: dust_collection_path_readiness
new_categories.memory: A bounded dust collection/handling path can be represented as available or degraded without retaining exact collection equipment, routing or disposal arrangement.

new_categories.label: capture_collection_path_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Capture and collection components can each appear available while end-to-end capture-to-collection continuity is uncertain; continuity confidence is therefore a distinct structural state.

new_categories.label: environmental_boundary_monitoring_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in monitoring at a bounded terminal environmental or property boundary can be represented separately from source-control readiness without retaining exact monitor type, location, concentration or threshold.

new_categories.label: dust_control_monitoring_indication_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring/indication validity can degrade independently from dust-control equipment readiness without retaining exact sensors, alarms, values or calibration data.

new_categories.label: dust_control_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, water, air, control, maintenance or other support dependencies can degrade separately from delivered dust-control service without retaining exact support topology.

new_categories.label: terminal_dust_control_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Dust-control assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_dust_control_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to source containment, suppression, extraction/capture, collection path, boundary monitoring or support state, while cleanup, throughput loss, complaints or schedule effects do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_terminal_dust_control_restoration
new_categories.memory: Source-control recovery, suppression/extraction recovery, collection-path verification, boundary-monitoring return, environmental-assurance recovery and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: terminal_dust_control_vs_shipboard_dust_control
useful_refinements.memory: P121 shipboard cargo-dust control does not by itself establish terminal transfer-point, stockyard or environmental-boundary dust-control scope.

useful_refinements.label: dust_control_vs_berth_transfer_path
useful_refinements.memory: P129 cargo-transfer path can remain mechanically available while dust-control assurance is degraded, and dust-control degradation does not itself prove transfer-equipment failure.

useful_refinements.label: dust_control_vs_storage_reclaim_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P130 storage/reclaim readiness is distinct from dust containment/extraction/collection assurance even when the same stockyard or reclaim path contributes to both.

useful_refinements.label: environmental_boundary_state_vs_terminal_infrastructure
useful_refinements.memory: P021 terminal infrastructure/capacity does not establish the delivered environmental-boundary monitoring or source-control service-state.

duplicates.label: generic_control_collection_monitoring_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic control/collection, monitoring, support dependency, degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior assurance/service families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_separation
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded terminal dry-bulk dust-control and environmental-boundary questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact materials, concentrations, limits, capture rates, equipment, settings, procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive terminal dry-bulk dust-control/environmental-boundary orientation and source-discovery output; not environmental-compliance, dust-control operation, cleanup, maintenance, disposal or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact material, concentration, limit, equipment, setting, procedure, provider, complaint, incident or current-readiness fact.
